description:
Scope: Planning only for uncovered lines 11 and 50 in lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/ingress_status_ui.ex. Implement tests only; no production edit, new test seam, data migration, route or UI change. Exclusive test paths to edit:
- test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/ingress_status_aggregate_test.exs (line 11)
- test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/ingress_status_ui_test.exs (line 50)
Do not alter other tests, support files or production modules. Adjacent current tests already cover nonempty aggregate invariants, pending/terminal status maps and bounded refresh scheduling; retain every assertion. Serena get_symbols_overview returned {} for the Elixir source, so bounded source/test reads were used. Existing zaq-emb.27.2 owns the original generic ingress-status feature; this issue solely adds missing unit coverage.

Test-first scenarios and expected assertions:
1. Add an example in ingress_status_aggregate_test.exs for IngressStatusUI.aggregate([]). Assert the exact returned map %{status: :unsupported, summary: \"No enabled connectors\", connectors: []}; this invokes line 11, proves zero enabled connectors are not treated as :error/:pending, and distinguishes empty from the existing nonempty property (min_length: 1). Preserve the current property unchanged. No connector DB fixture is needed: [] represents the full input contract.
2. Add a table-driven or two explicit examples in ingress_status_ui_test.exs for IngressStatusUI.any_pending?/1 on nil and [] (optionally :unavailable), asserting false for each, to invoke fallback line 50; contrast with the existing map case asserting true for pending and false for terminal statuses. Neither a status key nor a Phoenix socket is needed for this direct guard fallback. An optional separate end-to-end helper-level assertion: construct a local %Phoenix.LiveView.Socket{} with ingress_statuses: nil and refresh_attempts: 0; assert maybe_schedule_pending_refresh/4 returns the identical socket. Do not use refute_receive or sleeps for this optional negative timer case: exact unchanged socket is the deterministic observable result, while direct any_pending? assertion is what demonstrates line 50. Prefer the direct test as sufficient unless an existing caller regression warrants this additional assertion.

Fixtures/helpers/isolation: Reuse ExUnit.Case async: true and aliases already present in both files; use literals [], nil, and expected maps, not persisted connectors or external service fixtures. No new setup helper, DB sandbox, mock/Mox, NodeRouter stub, application env mutation, global state, external call, background process or timer needed in proposed direct tests. Existing timer test stays untouched and uses assert_receive on its own process mailbox. Keep async: true; if later extensions genuinely mutate shared state, move only those tests into a dedicated async: false module rather than weakening isolation or serializing these pure examples.

Property assessment: the order-independent nonempty aggregation invariant is already covered with ExUnitProperties in ingress_status_aggregate_test.exs. Empty input is one canonical boundary value excluded by min_length: 1, best specified by an exact example; the non-map guard is a bounded type-category fallback, best covered by concrete examples. No new property generators or broad input normalization claim is justified.

Operations/architecture: This changes no executable operation, Action, agent tool or cross-service call; Action-reuse gate not applicable. No new E2E: the same public helper contract is deterministically covered at unit level; no new UI journey or UX approval needed.

Validation ownership: Implementer runs only targeted isolated tests, e.g. mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/ingress_status_aggregate_test.exs test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/ingress_status_ui_test.exs, inspect failures without weakening assertions, and reports exact line 11/50 execution to parent. Parent owns mix q and final targeted --cover; this issue must not trigger the full test suite or coveralls. This planning subagent runs no tests or Git changes. Final gate/precommit and approval remain the parent's responsibility if applicable.

Unreachable/blockers: Both target clauses are reachable via public APIs as written; no prerequisite or hard technical blocker. A missing Elixir runtime/dependency or a targeted coverage report that still flags these lines should be recorded as an environment/instrumentation blocker, not bypassed with code changes, fake success, full suite or coveralls. Confirm coverage against the exact current source revision because line numbers can shift.
title: [coverage] IngressStatusUI empty aggregate and non-map pending fallback
